mcpWorkspace.title: Clipboard MCP
mcpWorkspace.localHint: Available on this device while ClipsX is running. Hiding the window keeps access active.
mcpWorkspace.assistantsHint: Separate credentials and permissions for each assistant.
mcpWorkspace.addDescription: Give an assistant its own access to ClipsX. You can revoke it at any time.
mcpWorkspace.nameHelp: A name to recognize this assistant in your access list and recent changes.
mcpWorkspace.afterCreate: Next, save the token and follow the setup instructions in your assistant app. Creating a token does not connect the app automatically.
mcpWorkspace.enableBeforeConnecting: MCP is not running. You can create a token now; enable MCP on All integrations before connecting or testing.
mcpWorkspace.emptyTitle: Your clipboard, available to your assistants
mcpWorkspace.emptyDescription: Add Codex, Claude Code, or another MCP-compatible assistant. Each gets its own revocable access token.
mcpWorkspace.readHelp: Search clips, read captured text and existing OCR, inspect stored images, and list available filters.
mcpWorkspace.writeHelp: Includes read access, plus creating new clips, updating tags, notes, favorites and pins, and undoing its own supported changes.
mcpWorkspace.safetyHint: Secret-faceted clips are excluded. Creating a clip preserves captured originals and does not replace the system clipboard.
mcpWorkspace.activityHint: Changes made through MCP. This is not a log of clipboard reads. Assistants can undo their own eligible actions.
mcpWorkspace.noActivity: No recent changes from external assistants.
mcpWorkspace.testHelp: Checks authentication and tool discovery using this token. It does not verify the setup inside your assistant app.
mcpWorkspace.enableToTest: Enable MCP on the overview before testing access.
mcpWorkspace.testPassed: Authentication and tool discovery succeeded; {{count}} tools available.
mcpWorkspace.revokeHint: Rotating the token or revoking access immediately disconnects its sessions. Rotation requires updating the assistant with the new token.
mcpWorkspace.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the text manually.
mcpWorkspace.deleteHelp: Remove this assistant’s access from ClipsX, including its saved token verifier.
mcpWorkspace.deleteWarning: This permanently removes the entry and disconnects its sessions. Clips and recent activity stay. The configuration inside your assistant app must be removed separately. You will need a new token to reconnect.
mcpWorkspace.removeExternal: Remove the configuration in your assistant app
mcpWorkspace.removeCodexHelp: For Codex CLI, run this command to remove the server entry named clipsx. It does not delete the token’s environment variable or disable other assistants in ClipsX.
mcpWorkspace.setToken: 1. Set your token in the terminal
mcpWorkspace.setTokenHelp: Replace PASTE_YOUR_TOKEN_HERE with your ClipsX token, then run the command.
mcpWorkspace.tokenSession: This sets the token for this terminal session. Run the next command and launch Codex from the same terminal. Repeat this step in a new terminal session.
mcpWorkspace.windowsTokenScope: The token is saved for future apps under your Windows account. This does not update the current terminal or already-running apps. It uses persistent environment storage, not an encrypted credential vault.
mcpWorkspace.sharedCodexConfig: This registration command requires Codex CLI. The desktop app and CLI share MCP configuration when they use the same Codex home and execution host. Saving the configuration does not give an already-running app the token.
mcpWorkspace.restartCli: Start Codex from this same terminal, then use /mcp to check ClipsX.
mcpWorkspace.restartDesktop: Fully quit Codex, including its background or tray process, then reopen it. Keep ClipsX running with MCP enabled.
mcpWorkspace.desktopTroubleshooting: Reopening a chat is not enough. If the app still inherits an old environment, sign out of Windows and back in, then reopen Codex.
mcpWorkspace.cliTroubleshooting: If Codex reuses a background server with an older environment, restart that server too.
mcpWorkspace.verifyMcp: In Codex CLI, use /mcp to check the connection. In the desktop app, check ClipsX in MCP settings for connection errors. A listed server is only configured, not necessarily connected. ClipsX’s Test access checks the token against ClipsX; it does not verify the external app’s environment.
mcpWorkspace.findTokenHelp: Codex reads CLIPSX_MCP_TOKEN from its environment. Run the command in the terminal you use to launch Codex. It displays that terminal’s token value; avoid sharing the output.
mcpWorkspace.findDesktopTokenHelp: This PowerShell command displays the token saved in your Windows user environment settings; avoid sharing the output. It does not show the environment of an already-running Codex app. Fully restart the app after changing the saved value.
mcpWorkspace.tokenUnavailable: If no value appears, no token is available in the location checked. Check where you saved it. ClipsX cannot recover it; if lost, use Rotate token in the assistant’s access page, update CLIPSX_MCP_TOKEN for your selected client, and restart Codex. Rotation disconnects existing sessions.

mcp.localOnly: ClipsX must be running. Hiding the window keeps MCP active. Cloud clients need a supported local bridge or tunnel.

aiConfig.title: AI configurations
aiConfig.description: Save several connections for each provider. Chat, background embeddings, and optional web search have independent selections.
aiConfig.error: Could not apply this configuration. Check the endpoint, model options, credential, and selections.
aiConfig.embeddingHelp: A replacement is verified before activation. Hosted indexing requires explicit enablement.
aiConfig.name: Connection name
aiConfig.credentialSaved: Saved in this device’s protected credential storage. Enter a value to replace it. On macOS, Keychain may ask permission to use this credential.
aiConfig.credentialHelp: Saved in this device’s protected credential storage. On macOS, Keychain may ask permission to use this credential. Loopback Ollama can work without one.
aiConfig.dimensionsHelp: Leave blank to use the model default. Ollama dimensions are discovered.
aiConfig.embeddingExecutionBounds: ClipsX sends at most {{bytes}} UTF-8 bytes per chunk and {{batch}} chunks per request. These are application bounds, not the model's token capacity. A smaller provider limit triggers adaptive splitting.
aiConfig.embeddingUnverifiedOptions: Custom model options must be verified by the provider. Chat context and output limits do not apply to embeddings.
aiConfig.hostedIndexing: Allow background indexing to send clipboard text to this hosted provider
aiConfig.capabilityHelp: Unknown capabilities stay unknown. Tool support is verified by the Recall runtime before automatic actions are enabled.
aiConfig.jsonHelp: Export contains connections, presets, and selections. Credentials, conversations, and MCP grants are excluded. Import merges by stable ID; detailed provider options can be configured here.

diagnostics.connection_test_failed: Connection test failed. Check the endpoint and credential.
diagnostics.credential_storage_unavailable: Protected credential storage is unavailable on this device.

recallOptions.noModels: No matching models. Configure a model in Intelligence.
recallOptions.reasoningHelp: Uses this conversation’s override. Default follows the saved model preset. More reasoning can increase response time and token use.
recallOptions.reasoningUnknown: No verified reasoning controls are available for this model. Default follows its saved preset.
recallOptions.savedUnavailable: The saved override could not be verified. Choose Default or a supported option before sending.
recallOptions.clipboardAutomatic: Clipboard tools are available automatically. The agent chooses when to use them.
recallOptions.clipboardUnsupported: This model is configured without clipboard tool support.
recallOptions.clipboardUnverified: Clipboard tool support will be checked when used.
recallOptions.webHelp: Web research requires a compatible model or a search connection configured in Models. It is off for new chats.
recallOptions.reasoningOutputHelp: Content returned by the provider. Some models return a summary; others expose no reasoning text.

recallPage.citationValidationFailed: The answer contained references that could not be verified. Your conversation and completed actions are saved. Inspect the sources or retry the answer.
recallPage.contextBlocked: The request, including instructions and tool definitions, could not fit the available context. Your conversation and completed actions are saved. Check model limits in Advanced; reduce attachments or older conversation where applicable.
recallPage.title: Recall
recallPage.subtitle: Find, understand, and work with your clipboard.
recallPage.searchPlaceholder: Words, an idea, or a question…
recallPage.searchFailed: Search failed. Press Find to retry.
recallPage.noMatches: No matching clips. Try different words or filters.
recallPage.retrievalIncomplete: These results cover a bounded search. Some sources were unavailable.
recallPage.deleteWarning: Delete this saved conversation and its attachments? Clipboard clips remain. Clearing clipboard history does not clear saved conversations.
recallPage.setupHelp: Search works without a chat model. Configure a connection and a chat preset to ask questions.
recallPage.operationFailed: Could not complete this operation. Try again.
recallPage.undoFailed: Undo was refused. The clip may have changed since this action.
recallPage.contextOmitted: Older context was omitted to fit this model.
recallPage.evidenceShortened_one: {{count}} attached source was shortened to fit this model, so the answer may rest on partial evidence.
recallPage.evidenceShortened_other: {{count}} attached sources were shortened to fit this model, so the answer may rest on partial evidence.
recallPage.evidenceOmitted_one: {{count}} attached source did not fit this model and was left out.
recallPage.evidenceOmitted_other: {{count}} attached sources did not fit this model and were left out.
recallPage.webUnavailable: Web research needs a supported model or a configured Tavily connection.
recallPage.interrupted: This reply was interrupted. Its actions were not replayed.
recallPage.chatEmpty: What would you like to recall?
recallPage.chatHelp: Ask naturally. ClipsX can search your clipboard, inspect sources, and help you work with what you find.
recallPage.composerPlaceholder: Ask, search further, or create something…
recallPage.composerHelp: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
recallPage.toolsUnavailable: Clipboard tool support could not be verified. This answer uses ordinary chat; no clipboard actions were run.
recallPage.allEligibleClips: All nonsecret clips · adjust search scope
recallPage.findExample: “Find the deployment notes I copied yesterday.”
recallPage.workExample: “Summarize these clips and save the result as a new clip.”
recallPage.searchCandidates: Matches found · the agent can inspect these next
recallPage.stopped: Reply stopped. You can regenerate it when ready.
recallPage.outputLimitReached: The model reached its output limit before finishing. Try less reasoning or increase the model’s output limit.
recallPage.requestTimedOut: The model request timed out. Try less reasoning or a faster model, then regenerate.
recallPage.responseFailed: The model request failed before finishing. Try regenerating the reply.

modelsWorkspace.connectionTestPassed: Connected. Discovered {{count}} models. This checks catalog access; model execution is verified separately.
modelsWorkspace.noCompatibleModels: No compatible models found. Refresh the list, show models with unknown capabilities, or enter an ID manually.
modelsWorkspace.savedModelUnavailable: Saved model: {{model}}. Its compatibility is not confirmed in this list.
modelsWorkspace.manualModelHelp: The provider has not confirmed this model's purpose. Verify compatibility before using it.
modelsWorkspace.catalogInferred: Purpose identified from a known model family; execution is not yet verified.
modelsWorkspace.catalogHelp: Discover models from this connection, then configure one for a feature.
modelsWorkspace.catalogEmpty: Discover models to browse this connection. You can also add a model ID manually below.
modelsWorkspace.removeProviderHelp: This removes the provider, its {{count}} saved model configurations, and its locally stored credential. It does not uninstall models from the provider.
modelsWorkspace.removeModelHelp: This removes the saved model configuration. The provider connection and installed model remain available.
modelsWorkspace.removeAssignments: These feature assignments will become None. No replacement is selected automatically:
modelsWorkspace.removePreservesData: Saved conversations and clipboard items are kept. Chats using a removed model follow the remaining chat default, if one is set; otherwise choose a model. Removing active embeddings stops new indexing; keyword search remains available. Requests already in progress may finish.
modelsWorkspace.removed: Configuration removed. Affected feature assignments were cleared.
modelsWorkspace.credentialRemovalPending: Configuration removed. Secure credential cleanup is pending. Unlock your credential store and retry; cleanup is also retried after restart.
modelsWorkspace.savedHelp: Manage connections and the models available for each feature.
modelsWorkspace.title: Models, your way
modelsWorkspace.description: Connect your providers once. Choose the right model for each feature.
modelsWorkspace.noModelsHelp: Discover available models or enter an ID. Then assign them to features in Usage & defaults.
modelsWorkspace.usageHelp: Each feature has its own selection. One model can serve several features.
modelsWorkspace.recallHelp: Default for new conversations. Existing conversations keep their own model selection.
modelsWorkspace.extensionHelp: The host generates text for extensions using this model. Hosted providers receive the extension’s text input.
modelsWorkspace.decisionHelp: Used by tag, favorite, and pin rules and permitted extensions. Receives only eligible text; privacy checks use a separate assignment.
modelsWorkspace.rerankHelp: Reserve an OpenRouter rerank model for future search ranking. Saving it does not send clipboard content or enable reranking.
modelsWorkspace.webHelp: Optional Tavily connection. Web access stays off for new conversations.
modelsWorkspace.decisionSetup: Use an Ollama System One decision model, such as Laya. Install it in Ollama first:
modelsWorkspace.decisionResult: Synthetic test returned “{{choice}}” with {{confidence}}% confidence. Confidence measures preference between labels, not correctness.
modelsWorkspace.connectionDescription: Give each connection a name. You can keep several connections for the same provider.
modelsWorkspace.modelDescription: Save a named model preset, then choose which features use it.
modelsWorkspace.providerDefault: Leave blank to use the provider default. Support depends on the model.
modelsWorkspace.connectionChecked: Model discovery succeeded. Individual model capabilities are verified when used.
modelsWorkspace.emptyHelp: Start with a local Ollama connection or add a hosted provider. Clipboard search works without a chat model.
modelsWorkspace.localConfig: Configuration stays on this device. Credentials use protected storage; conversations and MCP access are managed separately.
modelsWorkspace.transferHelp: Portable JSON for connections, model presets, and feature assignments.
modelsWorkspace.transferPrivacy: API credentials, conversations, and MCP grants are never exported. Existing credentials stay local; new connections need their own credentials.
modelsWorkspace.exportAssignmentsHelp: Only assignments to selected connections are included. Other assignments are exported as None.
modelsWorkspace.previewCounts: {{connections}} connections and {{models}} models will be added or updated.
modelsWorkspace.assignmentsUnchanged: Feature assignments stay as they are
modelsWorkspace.mergeHelp: Records merge by stable ID. Unrelated connections and models are retained. Active embedding changes are verified before activation.

providerReasons.api_key_invalid: The Gemini API key is invalid. Create or copy a valid key and try again.
providerReasons.service_disabled: The Gemini API is disabled for this Google project. Enable it in Google Cloud and try again.
providerReasons.api_key_service_blocked: This API key is blocked from using the Gemini API. Check its API restrictions.
providerReasons.quota_exceeded: The Gemini project has exceeded its quota. Check its usage and quota in Google AI Studio.
providerReasons.resource_exhausted: Gemini reports that its quota or rate limit is exhausted. Check usage and try again later.
providerReasons.permission_denied: Google denied access. Check the key, project, and API restrictions.
providerReasons.failed_precondition: Google says a project requirement is unmet. Check the project setup and regional availability.
providerReasons.unauthenticated: Google could not authenticate the API key. Check the key and try again.
providerReasons.invalid_argument: Google rejected the request parameters. Check the endpoint and model settings.
providerReasons.not_found: Google could not find this API endpoint or model. Check the endpoint and model ID.

failures.credential_storage_unavailable: ClipsX cannot access secure credential storage. Unlock your desktop credential store and retry. On Linux, enable a Secret Service in your desktop session, then restart ClipsX.
failures.hosted_indexing_disabled: Enable hosted indexing in this embedding preset before making it active. This sends clipboard text to the provider, even when the model is free.
failures.provider_configuration: Check the provider endpoint, model options, and feature assignments.
failures.provider_not_configured: Configure a credential and model before using this connection.
failures.model_unavailable: The model is unavailable. Check its ID and install it in Ollama if needed.
failures.connection_unavailable: Could not reach the provider. Check that it is running and the endpoint is correct.
failures.provider_rejected: The provider rejected this request. Check credentials, model support, and the Ollama version for decision models.
failures.provider_rate_limited: The provider reports a quota or rate limit. Check its usage and try again later.
failures.provider_server_error: The provider reported a server error. Try again later.
failures.provider_timeout: The provider timed out. Try again when it is ready.
failures.invalid_response: The provider returned an unsupported response.
failures.input_limit: This configuration exceeds the allowed size.

automatic.ready: Automatically included {{count}} sources. Only relevant evidence should be used.
automatic.empty: No usable context was automatically included.
automatic.unavailable: Automatic retrieval was unavailable. The assistant can continue without it.
automatic.budget: No room for automatic sources within this model’s context limit.

recallContext.title: Context
recallContext.readHelp: Evidence inspected for this answer. Numbered references link back here.
recallContext.nothingRead: No clipboard evidence has been read for this answer.
recallContext.suggestionHelp: Local matches while you type. Attach a clip to send it with your next message; suggestions are not sent automatically.
recallContext.typeToFind: Type a message to find matching clips.

recallReliability.autoLimitsHelp: Use known model/server limits. Otherwise use the fallback values below (default context: 131,072). Output is additionally bounded automatically.
recallReliability.reportedLimits: Model limits reported by provider; server restrictions may also apply.
recallReliability.unverifiedLimits: Capacity is unverified; available model information or configured fallback limits apply. Review limits in Advanced.
recallReliability.compacted: Older conversation summarized. The full conversation remains saved.

decisionRules.title: Decision rules
decisionRules.description: Built-in secret detection stays active. Add model-based checks for new text captures; existing history and images are not scanned.
decisionRules.privacyModelHelp: Optional. Receives captured text for privacy classification. An on-device model is recommended; hosted models are allowed.
decisionRules.skipHelp: Checks run before saving. Recognized credentials are skipped immediately. With a privacy model, matching credentials are also skipped. The system clipboard is unchanged.
decisionRules.providerNotice: Choose Privacy checks and General decisions in Models. Text is sent to the selected provider. Local inference is recommended for privacy; a local Ollama server can also route cloud models. There is no automatic provider fallback.
decisionRules.failureHelp: If a configured check fails or exceeds the model’s input limit, the full clip is saved with a Not checked notice. It remains available to Recall, meaning search, and enabled extensions. Organization rules are skipped when privacy evaluation fails. Successfully detected secrets and matching Don’t save rules still follow your exclusion settings.
decisionRules.empty: No custom rules. Built-in secret detection remains active.
decisionRules.name: Rule name
decisionRules.question: Question to evaluate
decisionRules.questionPlaceholder: Does this contain confidential customer information?
decisionRules.effect_favorite: Would add this clip to favorites.
decisionRules.saved: Rules saved. They apply to future captures.
decisionRules.operationFailed: Could not complete this action. Check the rule, assigned model, provider connection, and input size, then retry.
decisionRules.testHelp: Try a draft before enabling it. Only this sample is sent to the assigned provider; it is not saved and no action is applied.
decisionRules.unreviewedClip: The privacy check could not complete. This clip stays private and is excluded from Recall, meaning search, and automatic extensions.
decisionRules.privateClipHelp: A privacy rule matched. This clip is excluded from Recall, meaning search, and automatic extensions.
decisionRules.originalHelp: Use Original to view the copied content.
decisionRules.providerSummary: Assign models in Models. Captured text goes to the selected provider, which may be hosted. On-device inference is recommended for privacy.
decisionRules.rulesHelp: Ask a yes/no question, then choose what happens when the answer is yes.
decisionRules.questionHelp: Write a yes/no question. True means yes; False means no. The action runs when the model gives yes a probability of at least 50%.
decisionRules.effect_mark_secret: Would mark this clip as a secret.
decisionRules.noEffect: This rule would take no action.
decisionRules.probabilityHelp: These are the model’s estimated probabilities for the answer, not a measure of correctness. Yes at 50% or above counts as a match. No does not mean the clip is safe.

intelligenceOverview.pageDescription: Search, privacy, models, and connected assistants.
intelligenceOverview.title: Your intelligence setup
intelligenceOverview.description: Find saved clips, protect new captures, and choose the models that help you work.
intelligenceOverview.assignmentHelp: Assignments show your choices, not provider availability.
intelligenceOverview.recallHelp: Ask questions about your saved clipboard context.
intelligenceOverview.privacyHelp: Check new text for secrets and confidential information before saving.
intelligenceOverview.decisionsHelp: Evaluate yes/no questions for organization rules and extensions.
intelligenceOverview.rulesHelp: Automatically tag, favorite, pin, or restrict matching clips.
intelligenceOverview.extensionsHelp: Rewrite, summarize, and generate text through permitted extensions.
intelligenceOverview.visionHelp: Recognize text in images using the native system provider.
intelligenceOverview.loadFailed: Some setup details could not be loaded. Retry to refresh them.
intelligenceOverview.providerHelp: Models may run on your device or with a hosted provider. Text is sent to the provider you select; native secret detection stays active.

automationRules.title: Automation rules
automationRules.priorityHelp: Rules run from top to bottom for the source app, then try All copied clips as a fallback. Only the first match runs. Up to 64 rules per extension.
automationRules.manualHelp: These conditions apply to automatic captures. Manual operations run directly. Results stay attached to the original clip; automation never copies or pastes.
automationRules.questionPlaceholder: Is this an email draft that needs clearer wording?
automationRules.conditionHelp: Uses General decisions. A Yes probability of at least 50% matches. Model errors stop this attempt; they never count as No. The selected provider may be local or hosted.
automationRules.always: Always run for this application scope
automationRules.shadows: This unconditional rule prevents later rules for the same operation and application scope from running.
automationRules.setupUnavailable: This setup is unavailable. Edit the rule to choose another setup.
automationRules.empty: No automation rules yet. Choose an application, setup, and optional condition below.
automationRules.loadFailed: Could not load automation settings. Retry to refresh them.
automationRules.actionFailed: Could not complete this action. Check the setup, General decisions assignment, provider connection, and permissions, then retry. Your draft is retained.
automationRules.consent: Allow {{name}} to process matching copies from {{applications}} using {{capabilities}} and save attached results? Configured model providers may run locally or be hosted and receive copied text. Conditions use General decisions before generation. Automatic work never copies or pastes.
automationRules.testHelp: Test enabled rules for {{application}} and the selected operation. Only the sample is sent to the decision provider. The sample is not saved and no rewrite is generated.
automationRules.testNoMatch: No matching rule — no operation would run.

outcome.no_match: No condition matched. Nothing was generated.
outcome.privacy_restricted: Skipped because this clip is private or contains secrets.
outcome.decision_unavailable: The decision check could not complete. Review the model and connection, then retry.
outcome.stale_context: Skipped because permissions or source context changed.
outcome.ineligible: This copy is not eligible for the operation.
outcome.prepare_failed: The operation could not be prepared.
outcome.enqueue_failed: The operation could not be scheduled.
outcome.failed: Automation failed. Review the setup and retry.
